clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952 and the purchase of the apple orchard, within eighteen months: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, distance between June and Walter as he worked long hours, Glen's fights at his new school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June's weeks in bed that first winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir by September 1953 where her anxiety eased and her letters thinned out. The shifts pile up around the family's upheaval in a new place and Walter's absorption in the orchard.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failed, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan, within sixteen months: Walter's heavy drinking by June, conflict between Walter and Glen over blame for the loan, the orchard sold at auction in October and the family moved to Ridgeport, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and talks with the bank, Glen's son Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, Nora beginning to wet the bed in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found in May 1969 and told to stop working, and Walter stopping his drinking by October 1969 and taking work pruning trees. The shifts show the family's response to the loss of the orchard and the move it forced.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen's loss of his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within eighteen months: Glen out of work most of that year sitting in his truck for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, Nora stopping eating properly and losing weight that summer, Nora keeping to her room and distancing from her mother, Walter drinking again after six years sober by December, and Nora eating again and making the track team by June 1976 as the period settles. The shifts show Glen's drop in functioning spreading through the household.

clusters.name: Wilma moved into Nora and Hollis's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990, within eighteen months: Nora and Wilma clashing over the children's bedtimes and meals, Hollis working late and distancing from the conflict, Hollis taking his mother's side, Owen having tantrums at preschool and being sent home twice, Wilma taking over Lily's care, Nora's eczema flaring on both hands, rows between Nora and Hollis most nights, and Wilma moving to a flat in town by June 1991 where Nora's eczema cleared over the summer. The shifts show the strain of three generations in one house and the triangle that formed between Nora, Hollis and Wilma.
